info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Enterprise Security Assurance API
info.description: The Enterprise Security Assurance API provides tools and resources for assessing and ensuring the security of enterprise-level banking services. This API allows users to retrieve critical security assurance information, including compliance status, vulnerabilities, and recommended mitigations. Common consumers of this API include security analysts, compliance officers, and IT administrators who need to monitor and enhance their organization's security posture. By leveraging this API, organizations can maintain regulatory compliance and protect sensitive financial data from emerging threats.

get.summary: Retrieve security assurance details for enterprise services.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to obtain comprehensive security assurance details related to the enterprise services offered. It provides essential information and insights that help in understanding the security measures and protocols in place.
